findings.description: The Lambda environment contains a hardcoded AWS access key ID and secret access key. Lambda environment variables can be read by principals with configuration access and by code executing in the function, exposing reusable credentials outside the function role.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security patches. This leaves the deployed function dependent on an unsupported execution environment with known or future vulnerabilities unremediated.
